voices.note: the mishna's anonymous first clause (143b.1): אין סוחטין... ואם יצאו מעצמן אסורין
מאי טעמא and its unattributed answer

props.gloss_en: the mishna: one may not squeeze fruit to extract liquids from them, and if [liquids] came out of themselves they are forbidden
R' Yehuda: if [the fruit is] for eating, what comes out of it is permitted
R' Yehuda: and if for liquids, what comes out of it is forbidden
Shmuel: R' Yehuda conceded to the Sages regarding olives and grapes -- [on his view, what comes out of them is forbidden]
the stam: since they are [things] for squeezing, he sets his mind [on it]
Rav: R' Yehuda disagreed even regarding olives and grapes -- [on his view, what comes out of them is permitted]
R' Yochanan: the halakha is as R' Yehuda regarding other fruit
R' Yochanan: and the halakha is not as R' Yehuda regarding olives and grapes
